speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the consultation. I will be asking you specific questions about your symptoms to determine the cause of your feeding intolerance and bilious vomiting. To start, how many hours after birth did these symptoms first begin?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, 3050-g (6-lb 12-oz) male, six hours post delivery. The newborn has had several episodes of bilious vomiting and is intolerant to feeding since birth. Was born at term following an uncomplicated pregnancy, though the mother missed several prenatal checkups. The patient's older brother underwent surgery for pyloric stenosis as an infant.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Malrotation with midgut volvulus.

The onset at six hours of life, bilious vomiting, and a strong family history of pyloric stenosis make this a surgical emergency; I am requesting immediate abdominal ultrasound and X-ray.
